text:
ana: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a concrete action list for rollout safety. TL;DR: auto-rollback hook, smaller blast radius flag, preflight checks, and a weekly incident-pattern review. I will start a tracker.

owen: Can you own the auto-rollback spec, @ana? Suggest it ties to a 5xx spike OR sustained p95 increase.

mina: I can take flag scoping + blast-radius controls. Will draft defaults and UI bits.

sre_jake: Strong +1 for preflight canary job. Synthetic requests, assert p50/p95 and error rate, plus cache-warm step before traffic shift.

deploy-bot: deploy started by @ana on branch rollout/safe-gates — build #7823

ana: Quick proto for gates (very rough):
```yaml
preflight:
  checks:
    - name: synthetic-smoke
      p95_latency_ms: 200
      error_rate_pct: 1
  timeout_s: 300
auto_rollback:
  conditions:
    - error_rate_pct > 5
    - p95_latency_ms > 1000
  window_mins: 5
```

owen: :thumbsup: Looks reasonable. A couple tweaks: rename window_mins -> evaluation_window_mins, and add a min_traffic threshold so tiny canaries don't trigger rollback.

ana: @owen good call. @mina can you include min_traffic in your proposal?

mina: Yep. Proposed defaults: min_traffic = 100 reqs/min; blast_radius = min(1% of users, 10 hosts); add an "emergency cutoff" toggle in the UI that operator can flip to immediately halt rollout.

product-ops: For enterprise customers we need an opt-out for auto-rollback (they want notifications first). Also document expected behavior in contract language.

sre_jake: Also recommend a monthly analytical job that groups incidents by rollout_id + model_version + infra_change to surface recurring patterns. Might help catch noisy canaries or flaky infra tiers.

ana: I'll create tracked work: AUTOROLL-21 (spec + infra), FLAGS-98 (blast-radius + UI), PREFLIGHT-7 (CI/preflight job). Goals: spec reviews by 2026-03-30, infra implementation by 2026-04-15.

owen: Can we standardize flag naming? Suggest ff/rollout/<service>/<short> to make enforcement and queries easier.

mina: I'll add a linter to detect naming and a migration script to tag existing flags with rollout metadata.

sre_jake: :eyes: Any objections to making preflight mandatory for Dedicated and Private deployments? I think we should require it for those tiers.

product-ops: No objections, but we need to surface that requirement to sales and update onboarding docs (possible impact on time-to-enable).

ana: I'll update the playbook doc and attach the tickets once created. Will ping when the spec is ready for review. Thanks all! :pray:

deploy-bot: build #7823 finished — tests passed and artifact published.
